name: M7.PrefixBits.left_step
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → ∀ (p : List Bool) (bit : Bool), p.length < N-1 → let j := p.length+1; j ∈ M7.PrefixBits.WA N p ∧ M7.PrefixBits.A N (p ++ [bit]) = (if bit then insert j (M7.PrefixBits.A N p) else M7.PrefixBits.A N p) ∧ M7.PrefixBits.B N (p ++ [bit]) = M7.PrefixBits.B N p ∧ M7.PrefixBits.WA N (p ++ [bit]) = (M7.PrefixBits.WA N p).erase j ∧ M7.PrefixBits.WB N (p ++ [bit]) = M7.PrefixBits.WB N p
guidance:
Actual fixed binary prefix order: left positions1..N-1 then right positions1..N-1, with anchored zero always selected. These definitions are the original compact descent state, no raw pair enumeration. selected has true decided bits, undecided all remaining positions; permit overfull selected weight because accepted PrefixCompleted.Base has no weight bound. Prove step equations using Finset.ext, mem_image, list.getD on appended singleton; split index before/equal/after p.length. Use omega for offset arithmetic and N=1 depth0. Base via membership bounds and true decided vs undecided exclusion. Once left_step/right_step hold, accepted PrefixCompleted.left_sets/right_sets and left_disjoint/right_disjoint give completed_partition; count_card uses actual accepted count_completed; card_union gives count_partition. At full depth WA/WB empty, accepted completed_membership forces both supports exactly selected, proving singleton subset (not claiming the leaf is always valid). All exact original branches retained. Return tactic lines only.
import M7PrefixCompletedAccepted

namespace M7.PrefixBits
/-- Positions 1,...,N-1; the first block precedes the second block. -/
def selected (N offset : ℕ) (p : List Bool) : Finset ℕ :=
  {0} ∪ ((Finset.range (N-1)).filter (fun j => offset+j < p.length ∧ p.getD (offset+j) false = true)).image (fun j => j+1)
def undecided (N offset : ℕ) (p : List Bool) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((Finset.range (N-1)).filter (fun j => p.length ≤ offset+j)).image (fun j => j+1)
def A (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool) := selected N 0 p
def B (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool) := selected N (N-1) p
def WA (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool) := undecided N 0 p
def WB (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool) := undecided N (N-1) p
def depth (N : ℕ) := 2*(N-1)
noncomputable def count (N w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool) : ℤ :=
  M7.PrefixSector.count N w E (A N p) (B N p) (WA N p) (WB N p)
noncomputable def completed (N w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool) :=
  M7.PrefixCompleted.completed N w E (A N p) (B N p) (WA N p) (WB N p)
end M7.PrefixBits
